name: chrome-nav
description: CLI to drive a real Chrome instance via CDP (navigate, click, type, inspect DOM/console/network)

scripts.build: rm -rf build && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=build/app/cli.cjs && cp node_modules/playwright-core/browsers.json build/browsers.json && cp node_modules/playwright-core/package.json build/package.json
scripts.package: npm run build && pkg build/app/cli.cjs --targets node22-macos-arm64 --output chrome-nav-macos-arm64
